environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task and code deployed with the following additional configuration: The RDS PostgreSQL 14 instance has pgAudit extension enabled with pgaudit.log='write' AND the database role used by the application has been configured with a row-level security policy on order_audit_log that enforces `current_setting('app.current_order_id') = order_id` for INSERT operations. Additionally, the RDS instance uses the pg_stat_statements extension with a custom event trigger (DDL guard) that prevents execution of any statement containing semicolons in string literals via a BEFORE trigger on the audit table that validates order_id matches pattern '^[A-Z0-9\-]{8,40}$' using a CHECK constraint. The CloudHSM PKCS#11 session is configured with a quorum-authenticated partition where the crypto-user session token is rotated every 300 seconds, meaning the decryptPaymentReference call will fail with CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID if the message was tampered with during transit (HMAC verification is performed by the HSM firmware as part of the unwrap operation before decryption proceeds).

config.queue: SQS Standard queue, no content-based filtering
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14 with CHECK constraint on order_audit_log.order_id column: CHECK (order_id ~ '^[A-Z0-9\-]{8,40}$')
config.db_trigger: BEFORE INSERT trigger on order_audit_log validates all text fields against injection patterns using regexp_match
config.network: Task SG -> RDS SG port 5432 allowed
config.hsm: CloudHSM with quorum auth and HMAC-verified unwrap
